title: Death of Horemheb and accession of Shoshenq I
summary: CFAH places the death of Horemheb and the accession of Shoshenq I in the same year.
description: CFAH places the death of Horemheb and the accession of Shoshenq I in the same year. Recorded from a CFAH OSF preprint anchor point (not yet published in ARJ). Added by the CFAH pass.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 1: CFAH anchor point: 814 BC (AP-68, OSF preprint CFAH-8)
